excerpt.zh: 我们认输，我们屈服了。快把你的舰队调回去吧，嘶嘶嘶
excerpt.en: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, kssk

texts.zh: 我们认输，我们屈服了。快把你的舰队调回去吧，嘶嘶嘶
texts.en: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, kssk

texts.zh: 到头来，我们发现战争并不能解决预算赤字。我们提议无限期休战。
texts.en: As it turns out, war was not the answer to our budget deficit. We propose an indefinite truce.

texts.zh: 不管公正与否，你方的确击败了我们。拿走你们的战利品吧，我们必定会卷土重来！
texts.en: Whether by honorable or dishonorable means, you have defeated us in combat. Claim your spoils and rue the day of our return.

texts.zh: 我们似乎低估了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的实力。不过放心，以后不会了。
texts.en: We appear to have underestimated your net value, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Rest assured, it will not happen again.

texts.zh: 你们长久的威胁使得我们被迫让步。希望我们今后不会再卷入这类纷争。
texts.en: Your constant terror has forced us to concede. May our enterprises never be plagued by a conflict like this again.

texts.zh: 我们认输，但别想太多，这只不过是[This.GetName]暂时性的挫折。
texts.en: We admit defeat, but do not think this is anything more than a temporary setback for the [This.GetName].

texts.zh: 为了避免无辜的牺牲，我们被迫结束这起冲突。但若再次进犯，我们将集结全星海的力量与你对抗。
texts.en: We have been forced to end this conflict to spare innocent lives, but continue on this path and we will unite the galaxy against you.

texts.zh: 我们被迫投降，但别以为我们会忘记你们是如何残忍杀害[This.GetSpeciesAdj]生命的！我们早就知道你们是这种人。
texts.en: We are forced to surrender, but don't think we will forget how callously you took [This.GetSpeciesAdj] lives! This is exactly what we expected from your kind.

texts.zh: [This.GetName]达成了一致，我们必须让步。你为限制我们成长的努力暂时而言是成功的。
texts.en: The [This.GetName] is unanimous. We must concede. Your effort to limit our growth has proven successful for the time being.

texts.zh: 我们别无选择，只能遵守你的命令。你为什么要这样对待我们？我们只想与你们共享此星系。
texts.en: We have no choice but to give into your demands. Why do you do this to us? We only want to share this galaxy with you.

texts.zh: 你们的胜利只是对我们信念的又一次考验。最终，心诚者将笑到最后。
texts.en: Your victory is only yet another test of our faith. In the end, the true believers will prevail.

texts.zh: 无论你们如何索取，我们都将成千上万倍地讨回来。等你们被烧成灰烬时，任何取得的胜利都将毫无意义。
texts.en: Whatever you claim, we will reclaim thousandfold. Your victory will mean nothing when you have been reduced to ash.

texts.zh: 我们的军团即将撤退，同时停止针对[Root.GetName]的行动。
texts.en: We are withdrawing our troops and ceasing military operations targeting the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们觉得[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]瘦弱，这一结论显然下早了。我们愿为自己的行为付出代价并接受你们的要求。
texts.en: Our assumptions about [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] weakness may have been hasty. As a token of our new experience, we accept your demands.

texts.zh: 我们已经受够了这场战争。拿走你想要的东西离开吧。
texts.en: We have had enough of this war. Take what you will and be on your way.

texts.zh: 你们已经展示了你们的强大，但不要错误地将其等同于智力上的胜利。
texts.en: You may have shown your military power superior, but don't mistake this for an intellectual victory.

texts.zh: 你们已经聆听了宇宙渴望和平的呐喊。为了结束无意义的冲突，我们马上退兵。
texts.en: We have heard the pain of the cosmos crying out against this conflict. To stop the senseless dissonance, we surrender immediately.

texts.zh: 为了全体[This.GetName]的利益，我们必须低头。希望你们可以对我们宽宏大量，假如胜利者是我们，你们也会希望我们这样做的。
texts.en: For the good of all of [This.GetName], we must yield. Show the same magnanimous mercy you'd expect from us.

texts.zh: 我们必须让步，但请记住我们的警告。如果你们执意沿着这条道路走下去，天知道未来迎接你们的将是什么。
texts.en: We must back down, but heed our warning. You cannot fathom what the future has in store for you if you continue down this path.

texts.zh: 你竟敢对拉你出苦海的圣手反咬一口？现在你们拒绝了我们的智慧，总有一天你们的后代会谴责这一愚蠢举动。
texts.en: You bite the hand that reaches out to save you from destruction. One day, your descendants will decry that you rejected our wisdom.

texts.zh: 年轻气盛的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]！你们怎敢宣称战胜了我们？
texts.en: Precocious [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]! How dare you claim victory over us?

texts.zh: 眼下我们决定退一步进行观望。尽量不要对未来的工作带来太大的破坏。
texts.en: The time has come for us to take a step back and watch. Try not to cause too much destruction in your future endeavors.

texts.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
texts.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.

texts.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
texts.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.

texts.zh: 金属。
texts.en: Metal.

texts.zh: 不。这一切都不该是这样的。这种混乱。我们到底怎么了？
texts.en: No. No this is not how this is supposed to go. The confusion. What is wrong with us?

texts.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……
texts.en: Finally. A worthy opponent...

texts.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……
texts.en: Finally. A worthy opponent...

texts.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……
texts.en: Finally. A worthy opponent...

texts.zh: 战争结束了。我们偃旗息鼓。
texts.en: This war is over. We admit defeat.
